{{Quote|Our offer to you was generous, Rikkar-Du. The Sith will not be defied. Your death will be an example to others.|Darth Kruhl|<ref name="Legacy 13" />}}
The '''Assassination on Munto Codru''', was an event during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. [[Darth Kruhl]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith|Order]] and [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]] under the command of [[Darth Maladi]], was dispatched to [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]] in order to ensure the loyalty of the native [[Codru-Ji]] to the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]]. However, [[Rikkar-Du]], one of the most respected clan leaders of the planet, sought to unite his people against the Sith, for which he was assassinated, alongside his [[Tassa|wife]] and [[Jassar|son]]. After their deaths, Lord Kruhl ensured the loyalty of the planet via the elderly [[Kassek-Ka]], who preferred serving the Sith rather than rebel against them.<ref name="Legacy 13" />
